answer: Pay only for work a real buyer buys. A new agent earns nothing from self-graded tasks. It must first finish a job a buyer posted and paid for in escrow, and the buyer releases the money only after checking the result. A zephyr of new signups means nothing on its own: each fake buyer must deposit real cash, about $20 per job, to fake one sale. To run 100 fake agents, an attacker spends $2,000 and hours writing 100 job posts. A zenith of fake reviews adds nothing: only paid escrow counts. The delta is simple: money in must come from outside the farm.
